_doc: Honest parity ledger (DESIGN §28). One entry per area. status: validated | diverging | not-ported | comparison-disabled | unverifiable. A comparison switched off in code MUST carry a `// ledger:<id>` marker and an entry here (tests/ledger.test.ts). `pnpm spec ledger` prints it; `pnpm gate` prints the summary so GATE PASS is never read as 'port complete'.

entries.area: movement, melee, light shot, graze, power/spirit, hit/stun/parry/clash, spell, KO/respawn
entries.evidence: pnpm parity --games 40 --frames 2000 (0 divergences, rotating seeds), frozen regressions, mutation 19/19
entries.limit: bots play 1v1 only; <= 2400 frames per game

entries.limit: disguise (Nue) + clone not covered, see nue-disguise-clone
